messages:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: error rate spike on promptbridge-v2 canary (5% traffic) — 11% 5xx on /v1/prompt/stream, elevated tail latency. Triggering incident channel.
raja: I'm on it, paging oncall (raja -> pager). Can someone confirm scope? :pager:
emma: seeing repeated KVCacheAssertion in logs and OOM-ish signs on a couple of canary hosts. Sample trace: `kv_cache_get: failed on shard 3 -> illegal_state`.
jon: rolling kernel selection change went out with this build — possible incompatible quantized path for long contexts. Are we able to kill the experimental routing FF? If we cut flag, traffic should go back to v1 stable.
raja: acknowledging. Preparing to flip feature flag. Calling the FF dashboard now.
raja: I ran: ```/ff toggle promptbridge-experimental --env=prod --action=off --reason="canary 5xx spike"``` toggled at 1718250032
deploy-bot: Feature flag promptbridge-experimental set to OFF by raja. Canary traffic diverted to stable-promptbridge-v1. Health checks re-evaluating.
infra-bot: Metrics: 5xx rate on /v1/prompt/stream dropped from 11% -> 0.9% within 30s of FF toggle. P95 latency returned to baseline. :thumbsup:
sasha: Support update: opening CS incident, notifying customers who hit the canary (filter: mobile api keys with promptbridge routing). Drafted short note for impacted customers.
maya: I'll prepare a public-facing summary for the status page and coordinate with comms. We should call this a rolled-back canary; need RCA later.
luke: any idea how many users were affected? quick query shows ~120 unique API keys saw errors (mostly sandbox/test). Flag flip mitigated for all keys hitting canary.
emma: We'll pin the rollout and add a kernel compatibility check before next canary. Creating follow-up task in SRE board.
jon: saving build + kernel logs, will reproduce locally. Holding on replay until infra gives green that no latent errors remain.
raja: handing off to day-oncall rotation: @jon will own follow-up, I'll close the page after monitoring window. If any customer escalations come in, page back.
infra-bot: Incident severity: sev2 (customer-facing degradation) -> mitigated. Page resolved at 1718250145.
raja: closing thread here — FF off, traffic stable, CS notified. Postmortem + action items assigned. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
